$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006, FLR-ADR-007, FLR-ADR-060): FS_site 0.1.0, registry/FS_site/spec.md. Applied to the extension's top-level data, extensions.FS_site, by a validator that implements FS_site and knows it (spec.md 1.2). FS_site adds no kind of element and requires no other extension: its data is the site's survey (spots and contour lines), its setbacks and its grading pads, records in the document's one space of IDs. IDs that are taken, survey points that disagree, a contour's repeated point, a pad that is not a simple polygon and setbacks without a lot are checked by the invariants (spec.md 1.3, 2.2, 3.1 and 4.1).
title: FS_site 0.1.0
description: The ground a house stands on: the setbacks from Core's lot line, the terrain a survey's spot elevations and contour lines make, and the pads and slabs that cut and fill it.

benchmark.description: 1.4: the survey's elevation of project zero, for labels: the survey's height of an elevation z is benchmark + z.

spots.description: 3.1: the spot elevations: an ID -> record map; the IDs share the document's one space of IDs.

contours.description: 3.1: the survey's contour lines: an ID -> record map; the IDs share the document's one space of IDs.

pads.description: 4.1: the grading pads: an ID -> record map; the IDs share the document's one space of IDs.

length.description: Core 2.1: a length, an integer number of base units of 1/1280 mm.

distance.description: Core 2.1: a length of at least 0.

point.description: 1.4: a point of the plan, [x, y]: plan coordinates (Core 2.3), each a length.

elevation.description: 3.1: the ground's elevation there, above project zero (1.4).

extras.description: As Core 1.7: data no specification defines.

contour.title: Contour line
contour.description: 3.1: a line a survey drew at one elevation; its vertices are survey points (FS-SITE-3.1.1: no two consecutive points equal).

elevation.description: 3.1: the elevation of every point of it, above project zero (1.4).

points.description: 3.1: its vertices in order; a closed contour repeats its first point last.

extras.description: As Core 1.7: data no specification defines.

pad.title: Grading pad
pad.description: 4.1: ground set to one elevation over an outline: under a house, a terrace, a shed (FS-SITE-4.1.1: a simple polygon enclosing a positive area).

boundary.description: 4.1: its outline in plan, a polygon (Core 2.6).

elevation.description: 4.1: the graded ground's elevation under it, above project zero (1.4).

extras.description: As Core 1.7: data no specification defines.

setbacks.title: Setbacks
setbacks.description: 2.2: the distances kept from the lot's edges (FS-SITE-2.2.1: only with a site boundary, and street edges that exist).

street.description: 2.2: the numbers of the lot's edges on a street (edge i runs from boundary vertex i to the next).

front.description: 2.2: the setback from a front edge.

side.description: 2.2: the setback from a side edge.

rear.description: 2.2: the setback from a rear edge.
